symptoms: Small dark water-soaked spots on leaves
Spots may enlarge and develop yellow halos
Fruit may develop raised dark lesions
recommended_actions: Remove and safely dispose of heavily infected leaves
Avoid overhead irrigation and prolonged leaf wetness
Use locally approved disease-control products according to their labels
prevention: Avoid working with plants when foliage is wet

symptoms: Dark circular spots on older leaves
Concentric ring patterns may appear inside lesions
Lower leaves may yellow and fall prematurely
recommended_actions: Keep foliage dry and improve air circulation
Use locally approved disease-control products according to their labels

symptoms: Large dark irregular lesions on leaves
Rapid browning or collapse of affected foliage
White growth may appear under humid conditions
recommended_actions: Use locally approved disease-control products according to their labels
prevention: Monitor plants frequently during cool and humid conditions

symptoms: No major visible disease symptoms detected
prevention: Remove diseased plant material promptly if symptoms appear
